=== Katakana P1814 readings neither pipeline can remove — ruling wanted per row ===

'''742''' top-level katakana <code>P1814</code> statements sit on shrines that also carry an
ojp-hani <code>P1448</code> official name. The カミノヤシロ remover only touches a value that is
'''exactly''' the name's qualifier minus <code>カミノヤシロ</code>; the other katakana pipeline skips
any item with an ojp-hani name outright. Anything in between is reachable by neither.
'''713 of the 742 carry a hyphen''' — they are fragments of a longer reading, not names.
(<code>Q11361262</code> 下立松原神社 is one: top-level <code>シモタテ-</code>, name qualifier
<code>シモタチマツハラノ</code>, correct hiragana already present.)

Write a disposition after each arrow. Full per-item tables:
